text: The footer of Santini's own web shop lists Santini Spa's sole shareholder and directing-and-coordinating company as Vibria Srl of Bergamo; the UCI describes Santini as an Italian family company founded by Pietro Santini in 1965.
short: Santini Spa's socio unico is Vibria Srl; UCI calls Santini an Italian family company.

source.name: Santini Cycling - La nostra storia (company footer: Santini Spa / socio unico Vibria Srl)
source.quote: SOCIO UNICO, DIREZIONE E COORDINAMENTO: C.F. 04536910161 VIBRIA SRL

additionalSources.name: UCI - Santini's 60-year journey at the service of cycling, its champions and its fans
additionalSources.quote: Founded in 1965 by Pietro Santini, Santini Cycling celebrates its 60th anniversary this year. The Italian family company has always been closely connected to professional cycling
